items.title: BRAC Bank offers perks on Honda, GAC vehicles
items.description: BRAC Bank PLC has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with DHS Motors Limited, authorised distributor and service centre for Honda and GAC vehicles in Bangladesh, to offer its premium banking customers benefits on vehicle purchases.

items.title: Spain overtakes Germany as Bangladesh's largest EU market for apparel
items.description: Spain has overtaken Germany to become Bangladesh's largest European Union market for apparel during the July-September period of fiscal year 2026-27

items.title: Govt backtracks to monthly VAT returns for businesses
items.description: The government has finally reverted to monthly value-added tax (VAT) return filing, scrapping the quarterly system introduced in July this year amid concerns over revenue collection and operational difficulties

items.title: VAT return deadline extended to Oct 25: NBR
items.description: The National Board of Revenue (NBR) has extended the deadline for businesses to submit their online value-added tax (VAT) returns for July-September to October 25, without interest or penalties
